skeleton.placeName: The Cairn of the Patient Lord

knot.transgression: The Patient Lord bound a procession by oath they could not break, so that someone would always go behind them.

motif.dangerLine: the barrow keeps its order, and you have joined the queue

prize.label: the crown worn first, and only once

bottomProblem.label: The Patient Lord
bottomProblem.wantNow: to be first in all things

appeasement.move: stand aside and let it go ahead of you

factions.name: the Barrow-Wardens
